title: Grave Lantern
tagline: Drag anywhere and the knight walks while his sword swings at the nearest skeleton. Hold the crypt for three minutes, then kill the Bone Warden.

title: Bone Tide
tagline: A barbarian holds a moonlit graveyard for five waves of skeletons, then the Bone King walks out of the crypt. Chop, dash, and spend rage on a whirlwind.

title: Bridgewright
tagline: Drag bolts into space to build any span, then press RUN. Nine vehicles cross in order; the deck shows you where it fails.

title: Gloamkeep
tagline: Tap a tower, then tap a moor tile to build. Embers buy towers and upgrades; if the lantern dies, the moor goes dark.

title: Archer Keep
tagline: Drag back to draw the bow and release to fire. Hold your keep against 2,600 orcs, sally out with knights, and break the orc keep.

title: Fishy
tagline: Steer a fish with drag or the keyboard. Eat anything smaller, run from anything bigger, and grow until the pond is yours.

title: PULSE
tagline: Four lanes, one thumb. Notes come from the same seed as the music, so they cannot drift — no song files.

title: Orbital Decay
tagline: Burn the thrusters and set the craft down before fuel and hull run out. Every descent is a new orbit.

title: Tank Duel
tagline: Drag in the lower band to set angle and power, then fire. Turn-based artillery with wind, ammo types and destructible ground.

title: Phone Blackjack
tagline: Bet, then hit, stand, double or split against the dealer. $100 bankroll, one thumb, six decks.

title: Zombie Breach
tagline: Last survivor in a fenced compound. Three lanes of zombies, one weapon, endless waves — drag the left pad to move, the right side to look.

title: Slice Party
tagline: Swipe through flying fruit for 60 seconds. Chain slices for combo bonuses and stay clear of the bombs — five dropped fruit end the run.

title: Rocket Run
tagline: Hold to fly, release to sink. Thread laser gates, clear saw blades and guard bots, and grab coin arcs. The rocket carries three hull points; the third hit ends the run.

title: Bubble Bay
tagline: Drag to aim and release to fire. Match three to pop, cut a cluster loose to drop it, and keep the wall above the danger line as the ceiling falls.
